scope: Integrated acceptance and final re-audit of model extension slots: translations.Text, attachments.One/Many and metadata.Value fields declared on the model, generated typed bindings, Builder.Models assembly, relation-batched loading, typed writes, request validation, inspection, undeclared-name maintenance and deletion cleanup

source_identity.note: shasum -a 256 over the changed and untracked Go files relative to the base, in git order; no listed file was modified after the final verify completed, and the digest was identical before and after the resumed PostgreSQL run

distribution: Local changes only; no commit, push, tag, publication or starter dependency update performed

environment.tools: Existing pinned gopls at bin/gopls selected through FOUNDRY_TEST_GOPLS
environment.data: Existing private test configuration read without printing it; retained isolated schemas; no database reset/drop, shared-store flush or new database server

verify-e05-final.note: After every E05 re-audit correction; includes fmt-check, vet, tests, fixture-check with the consumer compile-fail catalog, generate-check and docs-check

agent-smoke-e05.note: Includes the eight new extension-slot scenarios: generated-extension-owner, generated-extension-binding, generated-extension-slot, extension-slot-read, extension-slot-link, extension-slot-write, extension-file-accepts and extension-slot-field

test-postgres-e05.result: Stopped at the batch containing internal/workscope: TestAdmissionQueuesBurstsAndReportsOverload timed out after 20m under -race. The 162 root packages reported before the stop passed, including application, attachments, database/query, extensions, i18n, inspection, internal/generate, metadata, translations and validation.

test-postgres-e05-resumed.result: Resumed the runner's own arguments and batch size for everything the stopped gate did not reach: the remaining 69 root packages passed in 109 s and every consumer module package, including foundry.test/consumer (compile-fail catalog) and foundry.test/consumer/articles, passed in 562 s. Together with the 162 root packages that passed before the stop, every PostgreSQL race package except internal/workscope passed on this source.

workscope-diagnosis.result: Two passes, then group_test.go:87 'nested admission waited or succeeded context deadline exceeded' (a 40 ms bound under the race detector); the test's deferred Close then waits for a lease the failed path never releases, which is the 20m hang.
workscope-diagnosis.ownership: Pre-existing and unrelated: fault, internal/admission, internal/callback, internal/contextlink and internal/workscope are unchanged from the working tree base. Non-race runs pass (count=5). Not changed in this series.

statements.result: Loading every slot of an Article list issues 23 statements for 1 parent and 23 for 100 parents in one relation batch, 44 for 100 parents split into two batches, and 2 without slots. LoadMissing on loaded parents issues the same statements as an empty transaction.

list_loading_benchmark.conditions: Native PostgreSQL from the existing private test configuration; 1000 seeded articles, each with Title in two locales, Summary in one locale and one SEO metadata value; each operation reads the first 1, 100 or 1000 articles in one read transaction
list_loading_benchmark.conclusion: Generated slot loading through With costs about the same as calling the underlying translation and metadata batch readers directly: about 0.25 ms more for one parent, and within 4% at 100 and 1000 parents. Both are dominated by existing per-row identity validation and decoding inside the extension stores, which is a recommended follow-up optimization rather than a slot regression.

fixed: Projection DTO fields accepted the model-only name= tag option; the generator now rejects it with a projection regression case.

Relation-batched slot loading charged the row budget only after every batch; it now charges state.remaining per BatchSize batch and checks MaxDepth, with a unit regression that stops an over-budget load after the exceeding batch.
A locale key containing NUL or too long for a path segment produced an internal error; validation.Locales now reports it as foundry.supported_locale at the map path.

Attachment Accepts buffered uploads outside write admission; it now runs under the collection's admitted calls and shares acceptMedia with writes, with detection-parity cases for docx, text, svg, png and path names.
Text slot Rule and SyncIn disagreed on blank text; both treat whitespace-only text as blank, and MergeRule validates partial updates without requiring the default locale.
Metadata contract inference accepted enums and discarded malformed JSONContract errors; enums are not inferred and malformed contracts are reported.
Two models with the same extension owner name were accepted by the generator; duplicate owners are reported.
Undeclared-name output did not distinguish a truncated report; the command prints a (truncated) marker.
Generated field documentation did not say whether a stored name was pinned; notes now state pinned or unpinned names and per-kind write guidance.
The articles HTTP fixture duplicated the gallery file limit; it reads Galleries.Describe().MaxFiles.
Inspection received model extension declarations separately from the application that installed them; App.Models() is now the single source for both.
Weak or vacuous fixture assertions were replaced with specific error, orphan-after-delete, version-mismatch, pagination, nested-count, depth and cancellation assertions.
Blueprint and changelog text described undelivered behavior; both now match delivered source.
not_delivered: TypeScript locale-union output for translated text requires a compatibility review and was not delivered.
Scaffold flags for slot fields were not delivered.
limits: Deletion cleanup observers are installed on the configured extension database pool only; models deleted through another pool must clean up explicitly. This is documented in the guide.
Attachments publish outside caller transactions; applications commit the owner first and inspect Result.Publication on error, as documented.
The per-row identity validation cost of the existing extension stores dominates large list loads (see the benchmark).

decision: E05 accepted on this source. The only failing check is the pre-existing, unrelated internal/workscope race-mode timing test, recorded above and left unchanged pending a separate decision.
